title: Slope stability of tangent bundles of smooth toric Fano varieties
summary: We construct smooth toric Fano $n$-folds of Picard number $n+2$ whose tangent bundles are slope-stable with respect to the anticanonical polarization, for every $n\ge4$. The construction gives toric fibrations with fibre the del Pezzo surface of degree six over products of projective lines, parametrized by multisets of roots of $A_2$. Every nonempty multiset of nonzero roots with vanishing sum yields a stable tangent bundle.
